title: TEST - Runner Strength Template Fields Probe
workoutInstructions:
TEST WORKOUT - do not assign to real athletes.
Runner strength template field probe.
Focus on controlled movement, no sharp pain, no max effort.
Stop if pain increases.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.coachNote: Drive through heels. Pause 1-2 sec at the top. Keep ribs down and hips level.

exercises.name: Banded Clam Shell
exercises.coachNote: Band above knees. Keep pelvis still. Move slowly, no hip rolling backward.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.coachNote: Controlled depth. Knees track over toes. Keep torso tall and pressure through midfoot.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift with DB
exercises.coachNote: Hinge at hips. Slight knee bend. Keep DBs close to legs and feel hamstrings load.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.coachNote: Hips level. Do not sag or pike. Stop the set if low back takes over.

exercises.name: Single Leg Calf Raise
exercises.coachNote: Full range. Slow 2-3 sec lower. Use support for balance, not to pull yourself up.
